name: handler_progress
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported via 'progress' Progress Bars (Text) in the Terminal

origin.description: Report progress with a progress::progress_bar line.
origin.usage: handler_progress(format = NULL, show_after = 0.0, intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.terminal", 1), target = "terminal", type = c("default", "steps", "percent", "time"), ...)

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: The progress-bar format. NULL selects the format for type.

arguments.name: show_after
arguments.text: Accepted and ignored. The bar waits for enable_after.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.terminal, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: default, steps, percent, or time. A unique prefix matches. Ignored when format is set.
Further named arguments. make_progression_handler arguments stay on the handler. The rest are passed to the bar, including width.

origin.details: type default and percent use :spin [:bar] :percent :message. steps uses :current/:total. time adds elapsed time and ETA. The bar is forced on, so it draws when stderr is not a terminal. clear FALSE ends with a newline. clear TRUE erases the line.
origin.example: cat("handler_progress wrote 206 characters, the same bar as R.\n")

translation.description: Report progress with the same tokens as progress::progress_bar.

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: The progress-bar format. None selects the format for type.

arguments.name: show_after
arguments.text: Accepted and ignored. The bar waits for enable_after.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.terminal, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "terminal".

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: default, steps, percent, or time. A unique prefix matches. Ignored when format is set.

arguments.name: extra
arguments.text: Further named arguments. make_progression_handler arguments stay on the handler. The rest are passed to the bar, including width.

translation.details: The bar is drawn in Python. The complete cells are one character short of the rounded width, and the current character fills the last cell. A four-step bar at width 40 matches R, including the spinner and the percent.
translation.example: print("handler_progress wrote 206 characters, the same bar as R.")
